# plainpm — GitHub Copilot Instructions

You are working inside a markdown-based project management system called **plainpm**. All data lives in plain text markdown files with YAML front matter inside the `data/` subdirectory.

## Required reading

Before doing anything, read these files to understand the system:

1. **`CLAUDE.md`** — All conventions: team roster, statuses, priorities, task IDs, file locations, year-based organization, meeting processing rules, dashboard scripts.
2. **`INSTRUCTIONS.md`** — Complete usage guide with examples for every operation.

These two files are the single source of truth. Follow them exactly.

## Data directory

All user data lives in `data/` (projects, team, meetings, reports). This directory is gitignored by default. If it doesn't exist, commands that write data will offer to create it.

## Available commands

Command prompts are in `prompts/commands/`. When the user asks to run a command, read the corresponding file and follow its instructions:

| User request | Prompt file |
|-------------|-------------|
| "Run today dashboard" or "today" | `prompts/commands/today.md` |
| "Run weekly dashboard" or "this week" | `prompts/commands/this_week.md` |
| "Show team workload" or "my team" | `prompts/commands/my_team.md` |
| "Weekly report" | `prompts/commands/weekly_report.md` |
| "Create a new task" + description | `prompts/commands/new_task.md` |
| "Process meeting" + file path | `prompts/commands/process_meeting.md` |
| "Project status" + optional project | `prompts/commands/status.md` |
| "Done" + task ID(s) | `prompts/commands/done.md` |
| "Update" + natural language changes | `prompts/commands/update.md` |
| "Meeting agenda" or "agenda" + optional project | `prompts/commands/agenda.md` |

## Key rules

- All tasks, meeting notes, and reports go in **year subfolders** (e.g., `tasks/2026/`) inside `data/`
- Task IDs auto-increment across all years — scan all year folders to find the highest
- Meeting notes favor **completeness over brevity** — never aggressively summarize
- Only create task files for **team members** (including yourself) — external attendees' action items stay in meeting notes only
- plainpm works in **solo mode** (one team member) or **team mode** (multiple) — detect by counting `data/team/*.md` files
- Dashboards are generated by `python scripts/dashboard.py <command>` — always use the script, never manually build dashboard output
- Every dashboard run saves a snapshot to `data/reports/<type>/YYYY/`
